scenarios.title: A coin flip with a call is won when the call matches the result and lost otherwise, and the win or loss selects the branch

setup.notes: The coin result is fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: A activates Frenetic Efreet's {0} ability (flip a coin; win: it phases out; lose: sacrifice it). No mana is paid.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and the coin lands heads.

variants.label: call matches
variants.expected: A wins the flip. Frenetic Efreet phases out and is not sacrificed; it is not in A's graveyard.

variants.label: call misses
variants.delta: The coin lands tails instead of heads.
variants.expected: A loses the flip. Frenetic Efreet is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard; it does not phase out.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge asks the flipper to call heads or tails and compares the call with a random result; the scenario needs the result forced.

scenarios.title: A coin flip that only cares about heads or tails has no winner, so win-a-flip triggers stay quiet

setup.notes: The coin results are fixed by the scenario, not random.

decisions: A casts Molten Sentry, tapping four Mountains.
Both players pass; Molten Sentry resolves.
As Molten Sentry enters, its controller flips a coin without calling it; the coin lands heads.

variants.label: sentry heads
variants.expected: Molten Sentry enters as a 5/2 creature with haste. Toothy and Zndrsplt's win-a-flip trigger does not fire; it stays a 2/2 with no counters.

variants.label: sentry tails
variants.delta: The coin lands tails instead of heads.
variants.expected: Molten Sentry enters as a 2/5 creature with defender. Toothy and Zndrsplt's win-a-flip trigger does not fire; it stays a 2/2 with no counters.

variants.label: flip with a call
variants.delta: A does not cast Molten Sentry. Instead A activates Frenetic Efreet's {0} ability, calls heads, and the coin lands heads.
variants.expected: A wins the flip. Toothy and Zndrsplt's trigger fires and it gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3). Frenetic Efreet phases out. Molten Sentry stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's NoCall flips fire no FlippedCoin trigger; flips with a call fire one with Result true (win) or false (lose).

scenarios.title: An effect that states a flip result replaces the actual result, so a player wins a flip the coin would not have given

setup.notes: A has not flipped a coin this turn. The natural coin results are fixed by the scenario: every flip would land tails.

decisions: A activates the first Frenetic Efreet's {0} ability (flip a coin; win: it phases out; lose: sacrifice it).
Both players pass; the ability resolves. The coin would land tails.

variants.label: first flip of the turn
variants.expected: Edgar's effect replaces the result: the coin comes up heads and A wins the flip. The first Frenetic Efreet phases out and is not sacrificed. The second Frenetic Efreet is untouched.

variants.label: no Edgar
variants.delta: Edgar, King of Figaro is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The coin lands tails and A loses the flip. The first Frenetic Efreet is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: second flip of the turn
variants.delta: After the first Efreet's ability resolves, A activates the second Frenetic Efreet's {0} ability, calls heads, and the coin would land tails.
variants.expected: The first Frenetic Efreet phases out (forced win). Edgar no longer applies, so the second flip is lost: the second Frenetic Efreet is sacrificed and moves to A's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Implemented as Mode$ FlipCoinMod with CheckSVar Count$YouFlipThisTurn EQ0; the natural result must be forced to tails.
